notes: x/y are pixel coordinates on the bundled 128x128 johto_region_map.png.

Computed by proportionally scaling the real 28x15 MAPSEC grid cell (or bounding rect, for multi-cell sections) onto the 128x128 image - the exact native-GBA pixel offset used by the live in-game area-screen renderer for this specific flattened map export was not confirmed, so this is a proportional approximation of real grid data, not a bit-exact reproduction.
A species can have multiple marker points (found in multiple areas).
